title: Mobile Automation Test Engineer
description:
Greetings from Coforge! 
 Coforge is looking for Mobile Automation Engineer with 6-10 years experience in Automation Testing, Mobile testing, API Testing, UI testing, JavaScript, Typescript, Mocking Frameworks. 

 Important Note 1 : We are looking for an immediate joiner for this role! If you're on a 30/60/90-day notice period, this opportunity may not be the right fit at the moment. We truly appreciate your understanding! 

 Important Note 2: Please apply only if you are available to attend a F2F interview in Bangalore office. Candidates from other locations or those who are unable to attend the F2F interview, kindly excuse. 

 Please find the below detailed job description and the company profile for your better understanding. 

 Position: Mobile Automation Engineer / SDET Experience: 6-10 years Job Location: Coimbatore Position Type: Full time Qualification: Any graduate Work Mode: Hybrid 
 Mandatory Technical Skills: Automation Testing, Mobile testing, API Testing, UI testing, Mocking Frameworks , shift-left testing, test pyramid design, Test Driven Development , Test layering strategies and CI/CD pipelines 

 Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer / SDET with strong hands-on expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, React Native, and modern test automation practices. The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks, improving test coverage, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

 Responsibilities: * Act as a technical guide for the QA and engineering teams on test strategy. Collaborate with developers, product owners, and QA engineers to define test requirements and ensure coverage across the test pyramid Design and maintain test cases, traceability, and defect tracking in tools such as Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail. Write and maintain Automated tests for backend Node.js Lambda services. Build and maintain React Native unit tests with React Native Testing Library and Jest. Develop and maintain Black box testing suites for Server, iOS, and Android applications Develop and maintain grey box testing suites for Server, iOS, and Android applications Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub actions Document test results, report defects, and track issues through resolution. Contribute to quality metrics, defect phase tracking, and release readiness reporting. Perform manual testing when needed for exploration coverage, triage, or validation of complex scenarios. 

 Expected skill set: * Strong experience in Test Driven Development Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines Strong experience in JavaScript and Typescript Experience Unit Testing User Interfaces like React, or React-Native Strong understanding of shift-left testing , test pyramid design , and test layering strategies. Strong experience with Mocking Frameworks Experience designing maintainable and scalable test architectures. Experience with data-driven testing, reusable fixtures, and clean code practices. 
 Good to Have skills: Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) Understanding of Docker and containerized testing environments Familiarity with testing serverless architecture Exposure to React Native Unit Testing Experience with Jest or ViTest Experience with Maestro Experience with Detox Experience in GitHub actions or Azure pipelines Experience working with Jira API Experience with API testing tools Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop validation or device-connected workflows. 

 Why Coforge? Coforge is a global digital services and solutions provider that leverages emerging technologies and deep domain expertise to deliver real-world business impact for our clients. Weve emerged as the 7 th largest Indian IT services firm . 
 Who We Are: Coforge is devoted to making the world a better place for clients, for our communities and for our people.
 
 What We Do: We help businesses transform into intelligent, high-growth enterprises through capabilities in Generative AI, Cloud, Data & Analytics, Low-Code Platforms, Intelligent Automation and Cybersecurity. 
 Coforge specializes in Data Governance, Digital Transformation, and Disruptive Technologies, helping clients to capitalize on their potential efficiencies. 
 Coforge has been an instrumental partner in the digital transformation journey of clients across a broad spectrum of industries: Health Tech, Fin Tech, Hi-Tech, Security, Digital Payments, Education Publication, Travel, Real Estate, Supply Chain and Logistics and Emerging Technologies. 
 Coforge operate across 25 countries, with 30 global delivery centers, and a thriving global workforce of 40,000+ employees. Our international network ensures that clients receive seamless access to the complete range of our services and expert knowledge and skills of professionals globally.
 
 Coforge has been recognized as a Great Place to Work certified organisation. 

 Coforge was recognized at the ET Edge Best Organisations for Women 2026. 
 Interview Levels: 3-Technical Interviews 
 Regards , Ravisankar P Talent Acquisition - Coforge +91 9994599336 ravi.sankar@coforge.com

title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Android
description:
Automotive Android Audio Framework Engineer Experience: 3?9 Years
 Domain: Automotive Infotainment
 Technology: Android Automotive / AOSP / Android Audio Framework
 Location: [Insert Location]
 Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for Automotive Android Audio Framework Engineers to join our Automotive Infotainment engineering team. The role involves development, customization, integration and debugging of the Android Audio Framework for production automotive infotainment systems. The engineer will work across the Android audio software stack, from Android Framework and Native Audio components through Audio HAL and underlying platform/DSP interfaces . The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with AOSP Android Audio Framework , excellent C++ programming and system-level debugging skills, and preferably experience developing audio functionality for Automotive Infotainment / Android Automotive (AAOS) products. Key Responsibilities Develop, customize and maintain Android Audio Framework components for Automotive Infotainment systems. Work with AOSP source code and implement audio requirements at Framework and Native layers . Develop and debug functionality involving: AudioManager / AudioService AudioFlinger AudioPolicyService / AudioPolicyManager AudioTrack / AudioRecord Audio Focus Audio Routing Audio Attributes Audio Devices Audio HAL Analyze and resolve issues across: Application ? Android Audio Framework ? Native Audio ? Audio HAL ? DSP / Audio Hardware Implement and debug audio focus, routing, volume, ducking, muting and stream-priority requirements. Work with concurrent audio sources such as Media, Navigation, Voice Assistant, Phone/Call and System Sounds . Debug audio issues including no-audio, incorrect routing, audio interruptions, audio focus failures, audio dropouts/glitches, latency and volume-related issues . Analyze audio behavior during boot, shutdown, suspend/resume and power-state transitions . Work closely with Audio HAL, BSP/DSP and hardware teams to identify and resolve cross-layer issues. Perform detailed root-cause analysis using logs, traces and source-code analysis. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, integration and defect resolution. Develop and execute unit/integration tests for Audio Framework functionality. Support system integration, validation and production releases. Own issues from problem reproduction ? root-cause analysis ? implementation ? validation ? closure . Technical Skills Must Have Android Audio Framework Strong hands-on experience with Android Audio Framework / AOSP Audio , including: AudioFlinger AudioPolicy / AudioPolicyManager AudioService AudioManager AudioFocus Audio Routing AudioTrack / AudioRecord Audio Devices / Audio Attributes Audio HAL Ability to understand and debug the interaction between Java Framework, Native Audio Framework and HAL . Programming Strong C++ programming skills. Good working knowledge of Java . Strong understanding of: Object-oriented programming Multithreading Synchronization IPC / Binder Memory management Good Linux programming and command-line skills. AOSP / Android Platform Hands-on experience working with AOSP source code . Experience modifying or extending Android Framework / Native components. Good understanding of Android system architecture. Working knowledge of Binder / IPC and AIDL . Understanding of Android build and integration mechanisms. Debugging Strong experience with: ADB Logcat Dumpsys Bugreport Android traces GDB Linux debugging tools Git / Gerrit Candidates should be comfortable debugging system-level issues across multiple software layers . Automotive Infotainment Audio ? Preferred Experience in Automotive Infotainment Audio is strongly preferred. Exposure to the following will be an advantage: Android Automotive OS (AAOS) Automotive Audio Framework Multi-zone / multi-device audio Audio routing and device switching Audio focus and ducking Media / Navigation / Voice coexistence Bluetooth audio / HFP / A2DP Phone / Call audio Voice Assistant audio USB / external audio sources Amplifier / DSP integration Audio codec integration Audio latency and synchronization Audio power management Candidate Profile We are looking for engineers who: Have strong Android Audio Framework fundamentals and hands-on development experience. Can navigate and understand a large AOSP codebase . Can trace an issue from Framework ? Native ? HAL ? DSP/Hardware . Possess strong analytical and debugging skills. Can independently drive complex technical issues to closure. Are comfortable collaborating with Framework, HAL, BSP, DSP, Application and Validation teams. Have a strong interest in Automotive Infotainment and Android Automotive technologies . Education & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline . 3?9 years of relevant software development experience . Hands-on experience in Android Audio Framework / AOSP Audio . Automotive Infotainment / AAOS experience is highly desirable. Why Join Us? Work on production Automotive Infotainment Audio systems . Develop expertise in the complete Android Audio software stack . Solve challenging problems involving Audio Framework, routing, focus, concurrency, HAL and DSP integration . Work on next-generation Android Automotive-based infotainment products . Collaborate with experienced platform, audio and automotive engineering teams.
